version.title: Protocol version
version.description: Use version 1 for native editor operations.

summary.title: Outcome or clarification
summary.description: Describe actual edits, or ask a specific question with operations empty when essential details are missing.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Visibility: 0 is invisible, 1 is fully opaque.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: Layer visibility begins at this absolute timeline second.

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.description: Layer visibility ends at this absolute timeline second; must exceed startTime.

zIndex.title: Z Index
zIndex.description: Stacking order: smaller numbers appear in front. Add background parts before foreground parts.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Optional built-in animation preset. Use keyframes for precise requested movement; omit unrequested animation.

prop.title: Prop
prop.description: Animated property: x/y are pixel offsets from the base position; negative y moves up. Scale is a multiplier; rotation is degrees; opacity is 0..1; blur is 0..100; curve is -100..100 and text only.

t.title: T
t.description: Absolute timeline time in seconds, not a frame number or delay.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value for this track's property: scale/scaleX/scaleY 0.01..20, opacity 0..1, blur 0..100, curve -100..100; x/y pixels, rotation degrees.

ease.title: Ease
ease.description: Interpolation toward the next sample: linear constant speed, easeIn accelerates, easeOut decelerates, easeInOut/smooth soften movement, hold keeps the value until the next sample.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Ordered animation samples. Use at least two distinct times to create movement, within the layer's visible time window.

keyframes.title: Keyframes
keyframes.description: Animation tracks. One track per property; distinct absolute timeline times per track. Updates replace matching tracks; [] clears all tracks.

x.title: X
x.description: Base left position in canvas pixels; animation x is an offset from this position.

y.title: Y
y.description: Base top position in canvas pixels; positive y goes down.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Primitive geometry only: rectangle, ellipse, or regular polygon. Compose several parts or use brush contours for other silhouettes.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Interior color as hexadecimal or transparent; a brush fill requires a closed contour.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Shape outline color as hexadecimal or transparent.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke Width
strokeWidth.description: Outline or brush line thickness in pixels; text/shape allow 0 for no outline.

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: Number of vertices for a regular polygon, integer 3..12; irrelevant to rectangles and ellipses.

drawDuration.title: Draw Duration
drawDuration.description: Seconds to trace a brush path when animation is drawIn, starting at startTime. Afterwards the complete drawing stays visible until endTime. Omit for a one-second reveal.

smooth.title: Smooth
smooth.description: Interpolate the brush points into a smooth curve instead of straight line segments.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Connect the final brush point to the first to form a closed contour. Use at least three points for a filled silhouette.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Interior color as hexadecimal or transparent; a brush fill requires a closed contour.

x.title: X
x.description: Normalized horizontal position inside the brush box, from 0 to 1.

y.title: Y
y.description: Normalized vertical position inside the brush box, from 0 to 1.

points.title: Points
points.description: Ordered custom contour points normalized to this brush's box, each coordinate 0..1. Separate disconnected strokes into separate brush layers.

color.title: Color
color.description: Brush line color as hexadecimal or transparent; does not set text color or interior fill.

strokeWidth.description: Outline or brush line thickness in pixels; text/shape allow 0 for no outline.

text.title: Text
text.description: Only the words or Unicode characters to display, preserving requested spelling, case and punctuation. Exclude styling, repetition and animation instructions unless explicitly requested as literal text.

textX.title: Text X
textX.description: Text box left position in canvas pixels.

textY.title: Text Y
textY.description: Text box top position in canvas pixels.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.description: Text size in pixels; choose a size that fits the box and requested repetitions.

lineHeight.title: Line Height
lineHeight.description: Line spacing multiplier relative to font size.

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: Typeface from the supported font names.

textColor.title: Text Color
textColor.description: Color of the displayed letters for solid text, as hexadecimal. This is the field for requests to color text.

backgroundColor.title: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Color behind the text box, not the letter color. Use transparent for no background.

isBold.title: Is Bold
isBold.description: True makes the letters bold; false uses normal weight.

shadowColor.title: Shadow Color
shadowColor.description: Text shadow color; transparent disables visible shadow.

shadowOffsetX.title: Shadow Offset X
shadowOffsetX.description: Horizontal text shadow displacement in pixels; positive is right.

shadowOffsetY.title: Shadow Offset Y
shadowOffsetY.description: Vertical text shadow displacement in pixels; positive is down.

fillMode.title: Fill Mode
fillMode.description: Use solid for one textColor, gradient for a blend of gradientColorStart and gradientColorEnd.

gradientColorStart.title: Gradient Color Start
gradientColorStart.description: First text gradient color in hexadecimal.

gradientColorEnd.title: Gradient Color End
gradientColorEnd.description: Second text gradient color in hexadecimal.

strokeColor.title: Stroke Color
strokeColor.description: Text outline color, not the letter fill.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke Width
strokeWidth.description: Outline or brush line thickness in pixels; text/shape allow 0 for no outline.

curve.title: Curve
curve.description: Text curvature from -100 to 100; 0 is straight.

imageY.title: Image Y
imageY.description: Image top position in canvas pixels.

scaleX.title: Scale X
scaleX.description: Horizontal size multiplier: 1 is original width.

scaleY.title: Scale Y
scaleY.description: Vertical size multiplier: 1 is original height.

saturation.title: Saturation
saturation.description: Color saturation multiplier; 1 is unchanged, 0 is grayscale.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Color temperature adjustment: negative cooler, positive warmer, 0 unchanged.

colorAdjustments.title: Color Adjustments
colorAdjustments.description: Media color correction; provide all four values when setting this object.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this color-key filter is active.

color.title: Color
color.description: Backdrop color to remove, six-digit hex RGB. Use the actual requested screen color; do not guess an arbitrary background.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Normalized RGB-distance threshold, 0..1. Larger values remove more colors; start conservatively.

edgeFeather.title: Edge Feather
edgeFeather.description: Soft-edge width, .01..1; .12 is the manual default.

edgeThin.title: Edge Thin
edgeThin.description: Shrink (negative) or grow (positive) the remaining foreground edge, -1..1; 0 leaves it unchanged.

chromaKey.title: Chroma Key
chromaKey.description: Live color-screen removal on this existing video/image, shared by preview and WebCodecs export. Supply all five settings. This is NOT subject segmentation of arbitrary backgrounds.
